# tcut — terminal sessions to video (for agents)

npm package: termcut · command: tcut · requires Bun ≥ 1.4 (or the standalone binary) · ffmpeg only for .mp4/.gif/.webm/.webp
Docs: https://github.com/AmanVarshney01/tcut · Reference: https://github.com/AmanVarshney01/tcut/blob/main/packages/tcut/docs/REFERENCE.md

## Non-interactive contract
- Every command exits 0 on success, 1 on failure. No prompts except `tcut publish --setup` without flags.
- Add `--json` to get exactly one JSON document on stdout (results, or `{ "error": "...", "type": "WaitTimeoutError" | "ExpectationError" | ... }`). Progress/status lines are suppressed.
- `-q` silences status lines without JSON. Status goes to stdout, errors to stderr (unless --json).
- Recording is cached: re-running an unchanged script reuses its .cast; `--force` re-records.
- `tcut rec` needs a TTY to pass keystrokes through; agents should prefer scripts or `tcut rec -- <command>` for non-interactive commands.

## Commands
tcut <script.ts> [-o out…] [--theme t] [--width px --height px] [--json]   record + render
tcut record <script.ts>                                                  cast only
tcut render <file.cast> [-o out…] [--theme t] [--speed x] [--json]       re-render (no shell is run)
tcut rec [-- command…] [-o out…] [--browser url]                         live session (TTY); writes .cast + editable .video.ts
tcut test <files|dirs…> [--json]                                         run scripts fast (no sleeps/typing delay), exit 1 if any expect() fails
tcut diff a.cast b.cast [--at s] [--images dir] [--json]                 screen-text regression check, exit 1 on difference
tcut publish <files…> [--json] · tcut publish --setup --endpoint U --bucket B --access-key K --secret-key S   S3-compatible upload
tcut init [name] [--template basic|tour|test] · tcut themes [query]
Outputs by extension: .mp4 .webm .gif .webp (ffmpeg) · .svg .html (no deps) · .png .jpg (final frame) · dir/ (PNG frames)

## Script shape
import { defineVideo } from "tcut";
export default defineVideo(
  { output: ["demo.mp4", "demo.gif"], cols: 80, rows: 24, theme: "catppuccin-mocha", typingSpeed: "40ms" },
  async (t) => {
    await t.run("ls -la");            // type + Enter + wait for the prompt to return (screen-aware)
    await t.expect(/total \d+/);      // assert on the rendered screen; throws ExpectationError with a dump
    await t.type("vim x"); await t.enter(); await t.wait(/~/, { scope: "screen" });   // TUIs: wait on screen text
    await t.escape(); await t.type(":q!\n"); await t.wait();
    await t.hide(async () => { await t.run("rm x"); });   // runs, but is cut from the video
    await t.sleep("1s");
  },
);
t methods: run type paste enter tab backspace delete escape space up down left right home end pageUp pageDown ctrl("c") alt("b") shift("tab") scrollUp scrollDown key("f5") raw sleep wait expect hide screenshot(path) marker resize clear print(markdown) title(text) zoom({rows,cols}) zoom(null) chapter(name) focus(target) screen() line() cursor()
Captions: print("## Step 1\nSome **bold**") shows rendered Markdown in the terminal (written to the recording only, never typed into the shell); title("Text") = big heading + rule + pause. Call them at a shell prompt.
Config: output shell prompt cols rows width height preset(readme|x|youtube|square) maxPause(idle compression) keys(key overlay) fps typingSpeed typingJitter seed playbackSpeed waitTimeout endPause quantize core cache font{family,size,lineHeight,letterSpacing} theme cursor{blink,period} padding margin marginFill borderRadius windowBar title loopOffset cast browser{url,width,height,fps,title,position:right|left|top|bottom|overlay,offset{x,y}}
Browser pane (scripted mode): t.browser.goto(url) / waitFor(/text/) / click(sel) / reload() / evaluate(js); t.focus("browser"|"terminal") for overlay z-order. Composited into mp4/gif/png only. Start dev servers as `cmd </dev/null >/tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &` (logs would repaint over TUIs; stdin must be detached or the job stops).

## Writing robust scripts for TUIs
- Wait for what you will react to: `await t.wait(/Choose a framework/, { scope: "screen" })` before pressing keys.
- Select by reading: `while (!/●\s+Cloudflare/.test(t.screen())) await t.up();` then `await t.enter()`.
- Agents in TUIs (claude, codex): wait for their trust prompt, press Enter, wait for the input box, type, then wait for a completion marker (e.g. /✻ \w+ for \d+s/ for Claude Code; absence of "esc to interrupt" for Codex), then `/exit` or `/quit` and `await t.wait()`.
- After a full-screen program exits the primary screen may hold stale text; prompt detection is cursor-relative, so `run()`/`wait()` still work. Use `t.hide(() => t.clear())` to tidy the video.
- Failures print the whole screen — read it; it tells you which prompt you are actually on.
